endpoints: fermion-generations (open_question node; why three generations + why the Yukawa/CKM/PMNS mass-mixing hierarchy)
casting_conditionality: GIVEN the audited frozen castings: standard_model cast as the regulated full-SM path integral with f = gauge-invariant correlators at the ~19 measured parameters, whose Sigma_f EXPLICITLY EXCLUDES any predicate expressing WHY there are three generations or WHY the Yukawa/mixing hierarchy takes its values (generation count and Yukawa pattern are MEASURED INPUTS, flagged non-definable from below); and fermion-generations cast as an open_question node (target-only, forces the E0/E3 branch). The required shape below is conditional on THIS casting. Two casting-sensitivities are load-bearing: (a) if one re-cast the SM in a GUT or string UV completion (standard_model casting_alternatives Alt-1; the E037 source), the gap would MOVE rather than close -- the generation count would still be a vacuum/representation-choice input non-definable from below, as E037 (string -> SM, E3) confirms; the casting smuggles an 'explanation' that the calibration forbids (must_not_seal_E1_or_E2). (b) The open_question node-kind is itself a casting decision that forecloses E1/E2 a priori; were a concrete generative substrate with accepted observables to be carded, the target would become an observable_readout and a run-object could in principle be exhibited (E0) -- but no such substrate is established, so the E3 casting is the faithful conservative one.
non_descending_object: A GENERATION-INDEXING / FLAVOR-SELECTION distinction: the discrete invariant that fixes the family number N_gen = 3 TOGETHER WITH the specific Yukawa texture (the mass eigenvalue ratios m_t:m_c:m_u etc. across families, and the CKM/PMNS mixing angles + CP phase). This object is in NEITHER endpoint's Sigma_f: the SM's Sigma_f carries the VALUES of masses/mixings as inputs but carries NO predicate expressing WHY-this-count and WHY-this-texture (SM card: 'NOTHING in Sigma_f expresses WHY there are three generations or the mass-hierarchy pattern'); and the open_question node carries only the question, no generative content. The missing object is the structural rule that makes 'family' a derived label and the inter-family hierarchy a consequence rather than 3x copies with hand-tuned Yukawas. Crucially it must carry BOTH the integer (the count) AND the continuous texture (the hierarchy/mixing), since E043 is deliberately split off to own the scalar-sector scale-selection separately -- E020's missing object owns the FAMILY-REPLICATION + FERMION-MASS-TEXTURE content only.
required_lens_predicates: A family-index predicate: a discrete label g in {1,2,3} that is INTRINSIC (read off the substrate) rather than an external multiplicity tag -- i.e. a lens whose Sigma_L distinguishes 'this is family 2' as a substrate fact, not a relabeling.

A selection predicate fixing N_gen = 3: a distinction that separates the realized 3-family world from 2-, 4-, ... family worlds the SM-grammar admits equally (anomaly cancellation alone permits other counts), so N_gen must be a non-trivial readout of L, not an input.

A texture predicate: a structured map from the substrate to the Yukawa eigenvalue-ratios and CKM/PMNS angles+phase, so the hierarchy m_i/m_j and the mixing pattern are CONSEQUENCES expressible in Sigma_L (the SM has only the raw values).

A non-factorization witness predicate: L must distinguish two SM states that are IDENTICAL in standard_model.Sigma_f (same ~19 parameters at the matching scale) but differ in family-substructure -- the operational B.2 emergence certificate (pi_1 does not factor through pi_0).

A run/audit predicate: a ledger registering that the generation-texture is generated only by stepping a substrate (no closed-form Yukawa shortcut), mirroring the QCD dimensional-transmutation audit -- distinguishing a genuine E0 run-readout from an unexplained E3 input.

relation_to_endpoints.standard_model: L is a richer PARENT ABOVE the SM (a strict extension / common-refinement candidate), NOT a layer the SM descends to. The SM is the SHADOW of L under the lens that FORGETS the family-indexing and texture-generating substructure, keeping only the ~19 renormalized parameters as inputs. Operationally: standard_model.Sigma_f is the image of L's lens after quotienting away Sigma_L's generation/texture predicates; the SM's measured Yukawas are L's run-readouts seen as bare inputs. This is the up-arrow: pi_SM does NOT factor through any object that already contains the count+texture (non-factorization), so L cannot be reached from the SM by derivation -- only climbed to.
relation_to_endpoints.fermion-generations: L is the WOULD-BE GENERATIVE LAYER whose accepted observables, if L existed and closed, would answer the open_question. The node is precisely the named hole where L's selection-and-texture readout belongs. fermion-generations is NOT a shadow of L (it has no content of its own); it is the placeholder for L's output. Closing E020 = exhibiting L such that fermion-generations becomes an observable_readout of L.

shape_verdict: richer-parent-above-both (a missing strict-extension / common-refinement layer L sits ABOVE the SM; the SM is L's family-forgetting shadow, and fermion-generations is the named slot for L's selection+texture readout). The hole is an UP-hole (emergence-up), not a missing descent.
role_profile: P2 Constraints (PRIMARY): L must carry a constraint/selection structure that picks N_gen=3 and the admissible Yukawa texture out of the larger SM-admissible family -- the family-selection manifold is L's P2 content; this is exactly the predicate standard_model.Sigma_f lacks.

P5 Packaging (PRIMARY): L's completion endomap must close on the generation-replicated + textured content (a fixed point that REGENERATES the three families and their hierarchy), so that 'three families with this texture' is L's idempotent packaged object rather than 3 hand-placed copies.

P6 Accounting/audit (REQUIRED): a monotone ledger certifying the texture is a RUN-readout with no closed-form shortcut (the no-shortcut / dimensional-transmutation analogue) -- this is what would distinguish an E0 (run-only, deferred) resolution from the current E3 (un-generated input).

P1 Operator-rewrite (CONDITIONAL): if L's generation structure descends to the SM with a forced effective term (a family-symmetry-breaking 'flavon' spurion as a route-mismatch correction), P1 carries that rewrite -- but under the audited casting this is NOT yet active (no established descent), so it is listed as the predicate a successful L WOULD activate, not one the atlas certifies.
conventional_candidate: A family/flavor symmetry (e.g. a horizontal/Froggatt-Nielsen U(1)_F or a discrete A_4/S_4 group acting on generations to generate the Yukawa texture), or string flavor structure (the generation count fixed by the topology -- net chirality / Euler-character or intersection numbers -- of the Calabi-Yau / brane compactification).

divergence.explanation: The SBT-required SHAPE (a richer parent L above the SM carrying a P2 selection predicate that fixes N_gen=3 and a P5/P6 run-generated texture, with the SM as L's family-forgetting shadow) MATCHES the STRUCTURAL TYPE of the conventional candidates: a flavor symmetry IS a family-indexing parent layer with a selection/constraint (P2) and a symmetry-breaking texture-generator (P5), and string flavor structure IS a UV parent whose topology selects the count. So the shape-as-type agrees. BUT the atlas's OWN internal evidence flags a sharp DIVERGENCE on whether any KNOWN candidate of this type actually CLOSES the gap, and on one structural feature: (1) E037 (string -> SM, scored E3 emergence-up, NOT E1/E2) is decisive atlas-internal evidence that the leading 'richer-parent' candidate -- string compactification, which the conventional answer leans on for the generation count -- does NOT select our vacuum: the landscape (~10^500) leaves N_gen and texture non-definable from below; the parent EXISTS as a candidate but does not discharge the selection predicate. So SBT's shape demands a parent that does what string theory provably (per E037) does not. (2) The required-lens P6 run/audit predicate (texture as a no-shortcut run-readout) is a feature the CONVENTIONAL flavor-symmetry answer typically does NOT supply -- a flavor-symmetry candidate deployed MERELY as a same-Sigma_f charge + O(1)-coefficient re-parameterization (the usual Froggatt-Nielsen presentation) fails the rubric's relabeling-is-not-a-connection gate E.4 and would NOT close the edge; a candidate that genuinely SPLITS an SM-Sigma_f-degenerate pair AND GENERATES the texture by an irreducible run would be a DIFFERENT case (and could move E020 toward E0). SBT does not pronounce on Froggatt-Nielsen as a theory -- only on the structural difference between a same-Sigma_f relabeling and a generative run. SBT's shape thus predicts the conventional candidate, AS USUALLY DEPLOYED, is UNDER-SPECIFIED: it provides the P2 family-index and a texture ANSATZ but not the P5/P6 generative-run that would move E020 from E3 (un-generated input) to E0 (run-only readout). VERDICT partial: shape-type matches; the atlas's edges say no established instance of that type closes the gap, and the missing piece is specifically the generative run (P5/P6), not the family index (P2) the conventional answer already supplies.

atlas_internal_evidence.shows: The conventional 'string flavor structure' parent is itself an E3 emergence-up edge, NOT a closure: vacuum selection (which compactification -> our generation count/texture) is non-definable from below (landscape ~10^500), no run picks it, no named principle closes it. The richer-parent candidate exists but provably fails the selection predicate -- direct evidence the required L must do what string theory does not.

The SIBLING structural-input gap has the identical signature (emergence-up, E3, open_question target, must_not_seal_E1_or_E2): a free SM input non-definable from below with no run and no named closing principle. Corroborates that E020's hole is the SAME KIND of up-hole -- a missing selection/generative parent -- and (clustering) that E019 and E020 likely share one missing layer (a structure that selects BOTH the gauge representations AND their three-fold replication).

Deliberately SPLIT OFF from E020 so the scalar-sector scale-selection (m_H vs cutoff) is a DISTINCT hole. This bounds E020's missing object: L must own the FAMILY-REPLICATION + FERMION-MASS-TEXTURE content, NOT the Higgs-mass naturalness -- a structural fence that keeps the E020 missing-layer shape sharp (it is a flavor-texture parent, not a scale-naturalness parent).

structural_vs_content.sbt_specifies: (i) the hole is an UP-hole: a richer parent layer L ABOVE the SM, reached by emergence not derivation (SM is L's shadow under family-forgetting). (ii) L's required lens must carry: an intrinsic family-index predicate, an N_gen=3 selection predicate, a Yukawa/mixing texture predicate, a non-factorization witness, and a run/audit predicate. (iii) L's role-profile is P2(selection)+P5(generative closure)+P6(no-shortcut audit), with P1 conditional. (iv) L owns family-replication+fermion-mass-texture ONLY (E043 fences off scale-naturalness; E019 is its likely co-layer for gauge-rep selection). (v) the atlas's own E037 forbids treating the string landscape as a closed parent -- L must SELECT, which no established candidate does.
structural_vs_content.remains_unknown_content: SBT specifies NOTHING about the actual new physics: WHICH symmetry group or topology realizes L; the actual mechanism that yields exactly three; the actual functional form of the Yukawa texture; whether L is a horizontal gauge symmetry, a discrete flavor group, a string compactification invariant, an anthropic selection, or something not yet imagined. The CONTENT of the missing theory is exactly what stays unknown -- SBT names the shape of the hole and the predicates it must carry, never the physics that fills it. Claiming to know the filler would be the reductionist relapse the calibration (must_not_seal_E1_or_E2) explicitly forbids.

out_of_sample_test: STRUCTURAL prediction NOT used to build this card: if any candidate L is proposed as the generative flavor/family layer, then on a declared finite toy model L's lens Sigma_L MUST exhibit a non-factorization witness against the SM -- i.e. two configurations IDENTICAL in standard_model.Sigma_f (same ~19 renormalized parameters at the matching scale) that L DISTINGUISHES by family-substructure (B.2 emergence test, pi_1 not factoring through pi_0). A candidate that only RE-PARAMETRIZES the Yukawas (Froggatt-Nielsen charges + O(1) coefficients, a same-Sigma_f relabeling) will FAIL this witness -- it produces no SM-indistinguishable pair that L splits -- and by the rubric's relabeling-is-not-a-connection gate (E.4) does NOT close E020; it leaves the edge E3. A candidate that PASSES (genuinely splits an SM-degenerate pair AND its texture is a no-shortcut run-readout, P6) would move E020 from E3 toward E0 (run-only). This test was NOT used to assign the E3 tier (that came from the frozen Sigma_f + open_question node-kind), so it is a genuine out-of-sample discriminator between a real generative parent and a relabeling.
confidence_note: FIRM that the hole is an up-hole / richer-parent-above with a P2-selection + P5/P6-generative profile and the listed required predicates -- this is forced by standard_model.Sigma_f's explicit non-definability flag plus the open_question node-kind plus the three corroborating emergence-up E3 edges (E019/E037/E043 all agree on the signature). The DIVERGENCE-verdict component (that no established candidate closes it, and that the conventional answer under-supplies the P5/P6 generative run) is FIRM as a flagged hypothesis grounded in E037, but is itself conditional on the audited casting; if a generative substrate were carded (changing the node-kind), the E0 route could open. No content claim is made or implied.
shared_missing_layer_hint: STRONG candidate to share one missing layer with E019 (standard_model -> gauge-group-origin) and a weaker link to E037 (string-theory -> standard_model). E019 and E020 have identical signatures (emergence-up, E3, open_question target, must_not_seal_E1_or_E2) and both are 'why THIS structure?' selections of SM inputs non-definable from below; a single parent layer L that selects the gauge representations (E019) would naturally also fix the three-fold family replication of those representations (E020) -- in most known UV-completion attempts the gauge group and the generation count are co-determined by ONE compactification/embedding choice. Therefore CLUSTER {E019, E020} as 'SM-structure-selection missing layer', with E037 as the shared (foreclosed) candidate parent. E043 (electroweak-hierarchy) is deliberately fenced OUT of this cluster (scalar-scale-naturalness, a different hole).

audit.verdict: SURVIVES adversarial audit as a DEFENSIBLE structural-requirement card, with the divergence correctly downgraded to 'partial' BY THE CARD ITSELF -- it is not sold as a discovery. The core shape claim (an UP-hole / richer-parent-above L, SM as L's family-forgetting shadow, role-profile P2-selection + P5-generative + P6-no-shortcut-audit, with the five required lens predicates) is FIRM: it is forced by the verified verbatim non-definability flag in standard_model.Sigma_f plus the open_question node-kind plus three corroborating emergence-up/E3 edges (E019/E037/E043), all of which exist and show what is claimed. The §9 anti-reductionism discipline is honored: no derive-across-layers (L is climbed-to via non-factorization, not derived), no up/down conflation (explicit up-hole, SM as shadow), and the foreclosure verdict is treated as the framework working. CONTENT OVERCLAIM is NOT found: every named mechanism (Froggatt-Nielsen, A_4/S_4, Calabi-Yau Euler character) lives inside the conventional_candidate and divergence-explanation fields as 'the conventional candidate AS USUALLY DEPLOYED', and structural_vs_content.remains_unknown_content explicitly disclaims knowing which symmetry/topology fills L. The OUT-OF-SAMPLE test (non-factorization witness splitting an SM-Sigma_f-degenerate pair; pure charge-relabeling fails it) is a genuine, falsifiable structural prediction NOT used to assign the E3 tier (that came from frozen Sigma_f + open_question node-kind). The DIVERGENCE HOLDS and is NOT a pure casting artifact: prong (1) [no established richer-parent candidate closes the selection predicate] is grounded in the genuinely E3-scored E037, real atlas-internal evidence. HOWEVER it is downgraded from a clean '5' because: (i) divergence prong (2) [FN under-supplies P5/P6, is mere relabeling] is a card-supplied, contestable physics judgment about a named mechanism that drifts toward the structure/content boundary and is partly an E.4-rubric artifact rather than forced by the endpoints; (ii) the N_gen=3 selection predicate imports the 'anomaly cancellation permits other counts' physics premise to shape the hole, a mild fit-to-physics that should be flagged as an external premise; (iii) the E019 shared-layer clustering leans on conventional UV-completion reasoning the discipline says to avoid. None of these rise to overreach or a manufactured discovery -- they are over-reaches in JUSTIFICATION, fixable by the listed hardening (re-stating contested physics judgments as structural conditionals and stamping the divergence block with its casting-conditionality). Net: a strong, honest firewall card; tighten the divergence-prong-(2) and clustering justifications to remove the residual content-adjacent and fit-to-candidate language.
